name: Enterprise Commercial Landscape and Market Scope
constraints: Commercial Landscape is a governed read-only profile and Market Scope is its versioned parameter set.
Released output is an immutable digest-identified projection and neither construct creates a business-object identity.
Party identity is reused across customer, supplier and partner roles while role-specific facts remain separate.
Customer and supplier monetary facts are never netted solely because they share a party anchor.
Market Scope declares seller entities, channels, intercompany rule, segmentation scheme and version, period, time horizons, scenario and disclosure grain.
Grouping cites a governed ownership, control or consolidation boundary rather than CRM hierarchy.
Unknown-parent relationships remain reason-coded singleton buckets.
Disputed group links preserve competing claims, claimant capacities and attributed result ranges.
Each order line, subscription charge or observed delivery has one fact key and one attribution path.
Rollups use set union of facts rather than sums of pre-aggregated subtotals.
Forecast, pipeline, quote, order, subscription, delivery and recognized revenue remain parallel measures with separate authorities.
Forecast coverage distinguishes backed, partial, unbacked-open, unbacked-lapsed and unevaluable outcomes.
World time, knowledge time, measurement phenomenon time, result time and ingestion time remain distinct.
Group membership never grants access; cross-controller data requires WM-XCT-002 authorization and WM-XCT-003 disclosure shape.
Released views pin input revisions, preserve attribution buckets and cannot be re-imported as source truth.
Each concentration run names exactly one grouping-boundary revision and exactly one fact key; a different boundary or fact key requires a separate projection.
Intercompany elimination applies only when the declared boundary is an accounting-consolidation boundary and both parties are inside it; ownership or control alone never authorizes elimination.
A Market Scope edition owns parameters only and stores no party, role, account, order, revenue or measurement fact; any parameter change creates a new immutable edition.

The projection digest binds the Market Scope edition, source revisions, fact key, grouping boundary, elimination rule, as-of, scenario, access-grant revisions, disclosure shape and calculation-engine revision.
Cross-controller facts are excluded by default and a missing grant yields omission or typed unevaluable state without revealing presence or absence.
Cross-period comparisons require matching fact key, grouping boundary and elimination rule or a pinned governed remapping.
Campaign and measurement context may annotate a window but never substitutes for the selected commercial fact key.
Two participating business perimeters produce two projections; a group view set-unions their facts without merging the perimeter artifacts by party identity.

A disputed group link is represented by a claimant-attributed hypothesis set inside one grouping-boundary revision; range endpoints are derived from those hypotheses without switching boundary revisions.

Coverage unevaluable is an evidentiary state; authorization denial is never emitted as that state and is externally indistinguishable from omission, with any denial reason retained only inside the authorization boundary under its disclosure shape.
The Market Scope edition is authoritative for its fact key and grouping-boundary revision; the projection digest restates those exact pins and any divergence is a hard failure.
Segmentation scheme, correspondence mapping and coverage policy are external governed references pinned by immutable revision; Market Scope cannot define or master them inline.

A cross-perimeter group view may set-union facts only when fact key, grouping-boundary revision and elimination rule match, or when an explicit governed remapping produces a new projection; otherwise union is forbidden.
holds: WM-ORG-014 and WM-ECO-020 remain non-canonical drafts with provider, relationship and entry-kind gaps.
WM-ORG-012 retains its parent/reference conflict and WM-MAT-008 has an open cardinality hold.
The supplier-role master WM-ORG-015 was not frozen in the source checkpoint.
Segmentation and concentration crosswalks, methods and fixtures remain unverified.
Frozen audit limits were remediated once; canonical enforcement remains required before publication.
